name: Eroded Sunfire
description:
Though the battle with the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire has ended, this ring-shaped flame yet burns.
In the beginning, in the deepest, darkest of nights, the master of flame emulated the sun, thus supplanting the light of the starry skies.
Though the flame's glow has been halfway corroded, it still reflects the world of old in its glory.
fullDescription: Though the battle with the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire has ended, this ring-shaped flame yet burns.\nIn the beginning, in the deepest of nights, as the darkness gradually consumed the starry sky and filled the people with fear, the master of flame emulated the sun by hanging rays of light throughout the sky, thus keeping the unending enemies from beyond the universe at bay.\nThough its glow has been halfway corroded, the glory of a flame that once illuminated the world of old still shines forth.
sources: Lv. 70+ Lord of Eroded Primal Fire Challenge Reward
